initial_upload_scope: Authenticated account and two current public 404 observations permit only an authorized initial upload attempt. Absence establishes no reservation, project ownership or guaranteed index admission; acceptance must be observed after upload.
scope: Manual release of identified software artifacts. Thesis acceptance, scientific conclusions and real adoption remain separate and are not asserted by a software release.
authorization_scope: The owner's current instruction authorizes preparation and manual TestPyPI then PyPI publication after applicable gates pass. This policy and supplied JSON never authenticate that instruction or grant upload access.

pending_decisions: Owner must choose the distribution channel and approve public disclosure.
Owner must assign release and vulnerability-response responsibility and a verified private reporting channel.
Complete STEP10 and the separately requested global review before any public release.
Confirm names, public documentation access, account ownership and publication protections in a separately authorized task.
Review exact artifact-bound dependency licenses, current vulnerability evidence and source-security findings; unresolved or unavailable checks are blockers.
Authorize publication of the exact version and artifact hashes after all gates pass.
